mathematical_contract.retained_carrier: Each compact rational cusp map retains one shared RationalBezier2 handle. The handle is one machine word in the map allocation and preserves the exact authored parameterization, conic lineage, and injectivity evidence needed to map a non-rational cut without materializing a point in the cusp field.
mathematical_contract.shared_image_gate: The general route first requires RationalBezier2::image_overlap to certify a positive-length shared rational image. Isolated contacts return no map, unresolved component evidence remains Uncertain, and no coordinate coincidence alone authorizes a global correspondence.
mathematical_contract.fast_paths: Structurally identical, reversed, and endpoint-projective control nets map the isolated parameter directly. An authored overlap may additionally produce a range-projective map. These paths retain the original exact root representation under rational transformation or unit complement.
mathematical_contract.general_mapping: After shared-image certification, the existing single correspondence authority attempts an exact conic chart only when a quadratic parameter frame exists, then an exact polynomial graph, exact point incidence for rational parameters, and finally a certified injective coordinate. The injective route transforms the source coordinate as an AlgebraicRootRationalMap, isolates every target preimage, replays target incidence, rejects zero or multiple matches, and promotes the unique exact result.
mathematical_contract.retained_conic: A previously certified implicit quadratic conic is visible at any rational Bezier degree. Higher-degree retained conics do not enter the quadratic-only parameter-chart implementation unless a quadratic frame also exists; they fall through to another exact correspondence route rather than panicking.
mathematical_contract.endpoint_fallback: A declined quadratic shared-conic endpoint shortcut falls through to complete exact point incidence. It is not interpreted as evidence that the endpoint is absent.
mathematical_contract.range: A mapped cut is published only after exact closed-range validation against the destination overlap, after applying destination reversal. An out-of-range cut remains absent and an undecidable order remains Uncertain.
mathematical_contract.policy: All image-overlap replay, root transformation, preimage isolation, point replay, coordinate equality, complement, and range predicates receive CurveContext. STRICT accepts only exact evidence. APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only at the common 512-bit predicate boundary and reports consumed approximate certainty through the existing policy machinery.
mathematical_contract.failure: Unsupported or unresolved correspondence remains explicit. No f64 conversion, sampling, tolerance, uncorrelated resultant-root matching, or finite projection is used.

capability.comparison_revision: Algebraic cuts crossed rebuilt/reversed rational and analytic maps only when native parameters were structurally equal, unit complements, or aligned through the existing cross-type predicate. A non-affine projective or nonlinear rational reparameterization remained Unsupported.
capability.source_revision: A selected algebraic cut now crosses any supported exact rational reparameterization for which the rational overlap authority can certify the common image and a unique exact target preimage. The regression covers Mobius, degree-four nonlinear, reversal, round trip, and independent selected cusp fields under both policies.
capability.new_work_per_expanded_fixture: Across the two policies, the source fixture adds 12 exact overlap constructions and 16 exact parameter transports, in addition to all comparison-revision work.
